rationale: Builds directly on the 9x512 two-block recurrent-tail best. The penultimate recurrent block is less float-rescued than the final recurrent block, so this adds a late smooth schedule that gradually downweights only the earlier tail recurrence during the export-sensitive endgame while preserving the proven two-block recurrence for most of the 600s run. The change is compile-stable, keeps the exact final eval path intact, stays under 1500 lines, and was syntax-checked with py_compile.
title: Late Endgame Tail-Recurrence Collapse On Recurrent-Tail QK Best
